osmTags.inscription: Hier wirkte Franz Max Rappolt Jg. 1870 deportiert 1942 Theresienstadt ermordet 25.11.1943
Hier wohnte Mayer Plonski Jg. 1898 verhaftet 1939 KZ Fuhlsbüttel ermordet 29.4.1940 Sachsenhausen
Im Vorgängergebäude dieses Hauses veröffentlichte Karl Marx beim Verlag Otto Meissner am 14.9.1867 den ersten Band seines Werkes „Das Kapital“, das die Welt verändern sollte.

eras.label: Mapped site · auto T1
eras.summary: Mapped outline, terrain and present-day surroundings from open data. No historic reconstruction.
eras.basis: Everything drawn is traced from OpenStreetMap ways (ODbL) and the Terrarium elevation tiles. Each element names its OSM way.
eras.conjecture: Walls and buildings without a sourced height are drawn as kerb-high plan lines, never as masses. Closed walls have no gates: none are mapped. The DEM is ~30 m source resolution: it cannot show terraces, ditches or scarps. Nothing historic is depicted.

notes: site: osm:way/59410285 historic=monument 36 m from ledger point

roads capped: kept the 150 longest of 269 mapped (trace size budget); minor lanes are not drawn
